card.title: Investment in the Next Round
card.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Selling the stall at a loss freed us for a much bigger opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We now know precisely which business not to buy again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We couldn't have learned it at this depth for free.
